description: A small flame spirit that actively hunts smaller creatures.
Some say the spirits of lost SiegeKnights burning with rage become pylooks
These scaled lizards are known to have an affinity for lava pools and tracking time
Their coiled tails lash out at anything that dares to cross their path. Always found in groups
The gentle emberfox, found in many homes as a pet. Perfect for winter snuggles
A fiery puppy that leaves scorch marks wherever it walks. Attacks on sight!
A salamander with a molten core. These lone siegelings seek the heat of the sun.
A predator that hides in smoke clouds, striking with superheated fangs before vanishing again.
Dracoil's leave the safety of the pack to travel alone, but they are known to return when the pack is in danger
A majestic stag with antlers of living flame. It heals allies as it runs, but catching it requires persistence.
Its gullet is a literal furnace. Once it locks its jaws, the heat alone does half the work.
The pylook's evolved form, formed on many pylook's fused into a single ghastly creature
The Solgator guards the lava pools of the Fire lands, they attack anything that dares to cross their path
This ancient Siegeling is said to be the soul of a powerful SiegLord who jumped into the Volcano to become Fire itself
Bundled up from within the snow, these small deerlike creatures are known to be shy
Frostflies are found fluttering along snowflakes, they rest on pine trees and have a fondness for winter berries
The Ice-Weee is a odd creature, its Ice-Cube shaped body can grow to intimidate other creatures
Ceeponee float through the winter winds and are known to be a bit shy
Large and imposing these cuddly creatures only want to find their companion and stay warm.
Trading the puffy for a Hooded Jacker, the Chilldoe has honed its fist into fearsome weapons
A gentle fawn made of crystallized snow. It heals nearby allies w.ith its aura but flees from conflict.
A well dressed predator that blends into ice fields. By the time you see it, its talons are already at your throat.
An ancient ice fowl. Nearly impervious to physical blows. Peaceful unless provoked.
A floating ice crystal that conjures devastating hailstorms. It aggressively pursues anything generating heat.
A spectral blade given sentient form. It glides through blizzards, striking with lethal cold precision.
An ancient ice wyrm that commands blizzards with a thought. Entire regions freeze in its wake. The undisputed ruler of the frozen wastes.
Tiny birds that gather in murmuration flocks. Their synchronized wingbeats create cutting air blades.
A hyperactive wind hound that barrels into anything it sees. Fast, reckless, and surprisingly tough.
A cottontail made of solidified cloud. Surprisingly resilient but bolts at any sudden movement.
A flowering plant creature that disperses healing pollen on the wind. Peaceful and slow to anger.
A swirling vortex with glowing eyes. It hurls cutting wind blades at anything it spots.
A raptor with wind-hardened talons that patrols mountain ridges. Its diving attacks hit like a battering ram.
A manta ray that swims through the sky, trailing stormclouds. Its wing sweeps conjure devastating gales.
A manta ray that swims through the sky, trailing stormclouds. Its wing sweeps conjure devastating gales.
A scorching desert wind given physical form. It hunts relentlessly, searing targets with superheated air currents.
A towering fog golem that drifts through highland passes. It protects lost travelers and only retaliates when harmed.
Weaves healing currents from the wind itself. Extremely hard to catch.
A massive gryphon wreathed in perpetual hurricane winds. It hunts from the eye of its own personal storm.
The sovereign of all skies. Aerovane moves faster than sight and strikes harder than a thunderbolt. Legends say it can split mountains with a wingbeat.
A blobby little creature made of mysterious goo. Travels in packs.
A tiny rock creature that rolls around aimlessly. Only fights back when provoked.
A hulking beast covered in razor-sharp thorns. Charges at intruders.
A squirrel-like creature armored in bark. Incredibly fast and flighty, it vanishes into the underbrush in a blink.
Tiny mud elementals that hurl clods of enchanted earth. Their aim improves dramatically when they group up.
An ancient stone golem draped in living moss. A true gentle giant.
A serpentine creature woven from fern fronds and ancient vines. It channels nature magic to entangle prey.
A burrowing predator that erupts from the ground to ambush unsuspecting prey with snapping jaws.
A hulking beast covered in razor-sharp thorns. Charges at intruders.
A regal stag with antlers of living crystal that resonate with healing frequencies. Fiercely shy and nearly impossible to corner.
A living garden on legs. Flowers and herbs grow across its shell, providing potent healing to all nearby allies.
A massive burrowing beast whose footsteps cause tremors. When it surfaces, the ground splits open around it.
Forged in the planet's core. An immovable gentle giant.
Forged in the planet's core. An immovable gentle giant.
Shadowy vermin that swarm in dark corners. Individually pathetic, but a pack of them can overwhelm the unprepared.
A bat-like hunter that drops from cave ceilings with razor talons extended. Silent until the moment of impact.
Slips between shadows. You only see it when it wants you to.
A serpentine wyrm made of living darkness. It devours light itself, casting devastating shadow magic from the void.
An ancient horror from the space between worlds. Extremely rare and dangerous.
A tiny orb of crackling electricity. It panics when approached, discharging sparks in every direction as it flees.
Electrified ants that march in formation. Their synchronized shocks can stun creatures many times their size.
A woodpecker whose beak delivers electric shocks. It aggressively pecks at anything shiny or metallic.
A tortoise whose shell crackles with stored static. It shocks anything that touches it, but never initiates conflict.
Tiny bolts arc between its tendrils, energizing allies nearby.
A burrowing creature that erupts from the ground in a shower of electric sparks. It headbutts targets with a charged skull.
A serpent of pure plasma that moves like living lightning. Its strikes paralyze, and it never stops hunting once it has a target.
A rhinoceros-like beast with a horn that acts as a lightning rod. Its charges are accompanied by deafening thunderclaps.
A floating jellyfish-like creature that drifts through mountain peaks, weaving devastating chain-lightning between its tendrils.
Lightning crackles between its claws. Hunts anything that moves.
The living embodiment of the storm. Thunderlord calls down apocalyptic lightning from perpetual thunderheads. Where it walks, the sky itself obeys.
A tiny water spirit that heals allies with soothing droplets. Commonly found near pools and streams.
A sleek creature that darts across water surfaces. Vanishes beneath the surface when startled.
A creature draped in kelp-like fronds. Its thick hide absorbs blows while it waits in tide pools.
Ceeponee float through the winter winds and are known to be a bit shy
A fox adapted to river life. Strikes with razor-sharp water blades from the shadows of rapids.
A turtle-like creature with a coral shell. Its hardened armor deflects most attacks.
Emerges from morning mist to strike with condensed water bolts. Fades back into fog when threatened.
A translucent predator that blends into ice fields. By the time you see it, its fangs are already at your throat.
A serpent that flows like water. Constricts and drowns prey in whirlpools of its own making.
A massive crab-like guardian. Rises with the tide to shield allies behind walls of water.
Summons healing rains and cleansing waves. Allies fight longer when a Brinecaller watches over them.
Commands storm surges and lightning-struck seas. Its tidal blasts devastate entire shorelines.
A massive yeti-like creature of compacted snow. It ignores most threats, but when provoked, nothing stops it.
The sovereign of the darkest depths. Abyssalking controls pressure, cold, and crushing darkness. Few who dive deep ever return.
